dialogues.speaker: Uncle Anpu
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you! How have you been?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Anpu
dialogues.text: Isak mentioned you to me earlier. Said that he wanted to thank you properly.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Anpu
dialogues.text: That kid's fond of you — I can tell. You're quite the example to him.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Anpu
dialogues.text: A good thing, of course. Always good to see children be enthusiastic and hardworking. Always glad to see that.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Anpu
dialogues.text: If you aren't going to be too busy in the next couple of days, perhaps you might want to rest your feet here. Aaru Village will always welcome you.
